neucler: Neucler is an AI sales copilot I built for dental receptionists. It listens to live calls and helps them convert more patients by suggesting relevant services.
faeth-studio: Faeth Studio is my creative design agency focused on 0-to-1 startups. I help founders quickly design, build, and launch their first high-impact digital products.
jim-coach: Jim Coach is an AI fitness app I designed and developed. It uses computer vision to watch your workout form and acts like a personal trainer right in your pocket.
neta-bridge: Neta Bridge is a B2B supply-chain marketplace I designed. It helps small businesses build trusted trade networks to facilitate high-value international transactions securely.
mytrials: MyTrials is a healthcare platform where I led the product design. We translated complex medical jargon into plain English so patients could easily find and enroll in clinical trials.
arrive: Arrive is a peer-to-peer marketplace I worked on. It allows people to turn their empty driveways into revenue by renting out their parking spaces to others.
